_comment_file: Frontend dependency manifest. Node equivalent of requirements.txt: 'npm install' installs these into node_modules. JSON forbids // comments, so notes live in _comment_* keys (ignored by npm) and in the README.
name: scholarship-network-frontend
_comment_scripts: 'dev' = local hot-reloading server on :5173; 'build' = produce the static files in dist/ that GitHub Pages serves; 'preview' = serve the built dist/ locally to test the production bundle.
_comment_dependencies: react + react-dom = the UI library and its DOM renderer; leaflet = the map engine; react-leaflet = React bindings for Leaflet used by the Day 3 map. NOTE: react-leaflet 4.x is paired with React 18 on purpose (react-leaflet 5 requires React 19).
_comment_devDependencies: vite = dev server + build tool; @vitejs/plugin-react = enables JSX and Fast Refresh. Dev-only: they are not shipped in the built site.
